<div class="card-body">
'''Gift Of The Mentor''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">師の導き</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：ルークと、オビ＝ワンかヨーダが一緒に戦闘に参加した際に使う。戦闘運命数を2枚引いて足す。2：1フォース消費してリザーブデッキを探し、ライトセーバーのカードを1枚手札に加える。デッキはシャッフルしてカットすること。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-82o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークは、オビ＝ワンの知識と導きにより、フォースについて学んだ。年老いたジェダイは、肉体の消滅後もルークを導き続けた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The mentor's guidance.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. If Luke and Obi-Wan or Yoda are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. Use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one lightsaber into hand. Shuffle and cut the deck.

'''Lore:''' Luke learned the Force from Obi-Wan's knowledge and guidance. The old Jedi kept guiding Luke after the body was gone.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Gift Of The Mentor]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
